extensionDescription.message: Displays SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication results as a banner when viewing emails. Shows DKIM alignment and domain registration date to help understand what authentication results actually mean.

optionsRdapDesc.message: When enabled, the sender domain is sent to an external RDAP server (rdap.verisign.com, etc.) to retrieve the registration date. Only the domain name is sent — no email content. Disabled by default.

optionsTrustedDesc.message: Comma-separated (e.g. mx.google.com). Only Authentication-Results headers added by these servers are used; headers the sender inserted are ignored. If empty, only the topmost header is used and the result is marked as unverified.

trustUnverifiedDesc.message: No trusted authserv-id is configured, so the topmost Authentication-Results header is used as-is. Set your mail server's authserv-id in the options. authserv-id:

trustUntrustedDesc.message: No Authentication-Results header from a trusted authserv-id was found. The results in this message may be forged. Topmost authserv-id:
